name: semantic_search
description: Flowork OS Sovereign Neural Semantic Search Engine. Performs fast local embedding vector search across .fl_brain and workspace files using FastEmbed ONNX models.

query.description: Natural language or technical search query for vector semantic search.

target.description: Target folder or path to scan (defaults to '.fl_brain').

top_k.description: Maximum number of semantically relevant results to return (default: 5).

include_chat.description: If true, indexes conversation history from portable-home/.flowork/chat_sessions with recency weighting.

recency_decay.description: Recency half-life in turns for chat history (default: 50.0).

keywords.description: Mandatory technical domain keywords in English.

reason.description: Mandatory technical rationale in English explaining WHY this tool is being invoked.
